title: SoulBound: Turnbattle | The tale of the Sun
description: Go to the grand RPG adventure with your old Friend!
body:
Do you miss the old times when you and your friend Niko were saving the world?
Well... Now you can save another one together! Or... _Compleatly destroy it_.

This is a Resource Pack for [SoulBound: Turnbattle](https://modrinth.com/mod/soulbound-turnbattle) mod, that changes default vessel to Niko and soul to the Sun! 

Don't forget to check the original mod author, and join their [Discord server](https://discord.gg/UwBYuDHtHz) if you got interested in the mod!
